rule.title: A distribution rolled over in full within 60 days is not taxable

when_missing.because: A distribution was kept unless a preparer says it was rolled over or was an HSA funding distribution

citation.wording: Generally, a rollover must be made within 60 days after the day you received the distribution.

rule.open_point: Exception 1's own instruction for this case is to enter -0- on line 4b. A direct rollover (box 7 code G) is decided by the paper (rule a-r-04); this rule is the 60-day rollover no 1099-R prints. A partial rollover's taxable part is the preparer's.
